description.value: A Japanese and Asian sushi restaurant in Victoria's Jubilee area offering dine-in service. Online ordering is available, making it convenient for touring cyclists to grab a meal without waiting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website successfully fetched and shows an active restaurant with current information. Phone (+1-250-595-0257) and website (https://togo-sushi.com/) match OSM exactly. Address matches (1883 Fort Street). Website confirms online ordering is available (takeout=true). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website, so these remain null. This is a legitimate, open, publicly accessible food service business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant offering food service to touring cyclists with online ordering convenience.
